transcriber_notes: niViz chart (transparent PNG, flattened onto white to read); 'Ram resistance [N]' axis 0-1000 with F/4F/1F/P/K labels, hatched bars grow leftward; columns θ, F, E, R only (no Comments/CT). Boundaries from leader lines and bar edges against height gridlines (11.78 px/cm, +-0.3 cm): 56, 50, 49, 40, 39, 29, 25, 21, 14, 6; the SH layers 50-49 and 40-39 are drawn taller in the table (dotted leader lines). Hardness from the numeric R column (1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 5, 4, 5.5), consistent with bar ends. θ (moisture) column blank throughout. Temperatures from red dot centres (bottom axis -20..0 C, 20.8 px/C, +-0.1 C); the 0 cm dot is half hidden by the frame. The red dashed vertical line above the surface (~-3.5 C) is the air temperature, not recorded as a snow temperature. Secondary glyph (box with filled lower half) read as RGxf per the symbol key; the heart-like glyph is three small joined open circles (MF).
